items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Right down Bourbon and Marie. Bourbon and Marie. Bourbon and Marie right down there.

ctx.x: What section of the city did you live in?
When we were young. Right down there. Right down Bourbon and Marie. Bourbon and Marie. Bourbon and Marie right down there.
I lived there for years. Oh, I see. And who were some of the musicians you heard before you started playing?
